title: Mattermost versions 11.8.x <= 11.8.5, 11.7.x <= 11.7.10, 11.10.x <= 11.10.2 fails to validate the type of card…
description: Mattermost versions 11.8.x up to 11.8.5, 11.7.x up to 11.7.10, and 11.10.x up to 11.10.2 contain a vulnerability where the type of card property fields is not properly validated. This flaw allows a board Editor to send a crafted PATCH request with non-string property names or values, causing a board or card to become permanently unopenable for all users.
